en.Weapon_A_Filed_Desc:
Rapidly fires in a straight ray in front of Player.

Deals average damage.
en.Weapon_B_Spread_Desc:
Fires three bullets in an angle, which expands by speed.

Deals high damage, if all can hit.
en.Weapon_C_Tracking_Desc:
Rapidly fires bullets that auto home in on the nearest enemy.

Deals very low damage, but you rarely miss.
